title: Homestead
description: Welcome to Homestead, a hand-crafted world brimming with quests to embark on, vibrant landscapes and endless building possibilities. Settle in, explore, and create the cozy life you've always dreamed of!
author: Tokimi
body:
Panel 4: Chapters Panel 5: Chapters Panel 6: Farming Panel 7: Building Panel 8: Building Panel 9: Building Panel 10: The cellar Panel 11: Plushies Panel 12: Fishing Panel 13: The lake Panel 14: Tokimi's note Panel 15: The lake at night Panel 16: The interface Panel 17: Machines Panel 18: Backpacks Panel 19: Gear Panel 20: The windmill Panel 21: The title screen Panel 22: Shaders Panel 23: Getting started Panel 24: CreditsJoin the Homestead DiscordRead the Homestead wiki Panel 25: Thank yous

Open to Read the Text on the Images Above # Homestead **#1 Cozy Modpack. In the entire world.** Welcome to Homestead. Settle down, play slow, farm, cook, and take in the world around you. 709 quests to walk you through it all. > **Minecraft 1.20.1 · Fabric · 709 Quests · 27 Chapters** --- ## Why We Built This Homestead is a passion project built from the creativity of Tokimi and the CozyStudios team. Over 5-6 months in the making, it is the result of hundreds of hours, thousands of dollars, and lots of coffee and tea. Whether you are here to build, explore, automate, or simply unwind, we hope you enjoy Homestead as much as we do. There is lots to do, lots of fun things to explore, and just an overall good time. > *"I have created Homestead for the sole purpose of wanting to have a pack that I would enjoy playing. It turned into something more than that really quickly, and it became what it is now. I hope yall enjoy."* > *— Tokimi* --- ## What You'll Do Here **709 quests across 27 chapters.** Here are 10 of them: - **Cogs and Whimsy** — 73 quests - **Catch of the Day** — 64 quests - **The Portable Life** — 57 quests - **Seasoned and Settled** — 53 quests - **Liquid Courage** — 47 quests - **Vines and Vintage** — 32 quests - **Roots That Run Deep** — 28 quests - **Forged Fables** — 27 quests - **The Whispers of the Wilds** — 26 quests - **The Heart of the Homestead** — 19 quests --- ## A Farmer's Life **187 dishes you can cook.** Till your fields, raise your animals, and work your way through nearly 200 recipes across the farming and food mods bundled in. --- ## The Home You Shape **35 ways to cut one plank. 6,981 chipped blocks in total.** Whatever your build style, there is a block for it. --- ## The Cellar and the Kettle **177 things to pour.** Barrels, kegs, and brewing stations full of drinks, broths, and specialty pours to sip or sell. --- ## Good Company **100+ plushies to find.** Collect plushies of mobs, YouTubers, and community members scattered through the world. --- ## Catch of the Day **33 fish in these waters, 12 tiers of crates to haul up.** - Rods on the Rail: 9 - In the Overworld, in water: 16 - In the Nether, in lava: 9 - In the End, in water: 7 - Plus a full set of cooked and crafted recipes to round out your catch --- ## The Cozy Interface Rebuilt menus and overlays so every screen in the pack feels like it belongs in the same world. --- ## Cogs and Whimsy **73 quests, the biggest chapter of the 27.** The full Create experience, with guided questlines that walk you from your first cogwheel to industrial-scale contraptions. --- ## Carrying and Keeping **6 packs to grow into:** Leather, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite. **57 upgrades to slot in** for stacking, filtering, pickup, magnet, cooking, and more. **37 ways to keep it all** across storage drawers, inventory connectors, storage terminals, and the rest of the Sophisticated Storage lineup. --- ## Forged Fables A full gear progression that goes beyond Netherite. **Diamond → Obsidian** (9 pieces): add an Obsidian Ingot to your diamond gear with an Obsidian Upgrade Smithing Template. **Obsidian** gets 3 extra pieces beyond the usual kit: Horse Armor, Nautilus Armor, and a Spear. **Obsidian → Netherite** (9 pieces): add a Netherite Ingot with a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template. **Past Netherite:** 4 more Netherite tiers above it (Iron, Gold, Emerald, Diamond, 9 pieces each) and 8 Mythic Gem kits off the side (Ruby, Topaz, Peridot, Sapphire, Jade, Aquamarine, Ametrine, Citrine, 72 more pieces). --- ## The Whispers of the Wilds Automated windmills, hand-built structures, and the full farm-life questline. It's farming time. --- ## Built-in Shaders Three looks ship enabled out of the box: **Dawn, Day, Night.** **Bundled in the pack:** - Complementary Reimagined (Low / Mid / Extreme) **Four more come with it:** - Nostalgia - Makeup Ultrafast - Potato - Super Duper Vanilla --- ## How You Start **1. Pick your launcher.** Install through the CurseForge, Prism, or Modrinth launcher. Minecraft 1.20.1 on Fabric. **2. Set the memory.** Give it 6-8GB of memory. Stay within 6-10GB; more than that can hurt instead of help. **3. Open the quest book.** Start a world and open the quest book. The First Sprout chapter walks you in. **4. Server and shaders.** Running a server? There is a dedicated Server Pack ready to download. Shaders come preloaded; turn them off in Video Settings if you need the frames. --- ## Credits and Doors *I hope you enjoyed it just as much as I loved creating it.* - **Pack, Quests and Lore:** Tokimi - **Team:** CozyCord / CozyStudios - **Secondary Dev:** Meleon - **Backend Dev:** Salad - **Logo:** Slugv - **Character Art:** BRY-LH - **Description:** Larsonix --- ## Special Thank You's Thank you to everyone who beta tested the pack, finding all the bugs and issues that we could. Xodk · Army · Lyn · Alexelle · Nylon · Gonzo · Cobra · Mama Native · Snowylasvegas · Wistericle · Yuki · Navinor Thank you to the mod developers who helped us with coding our very own mod and bringing to life our crazy ideas. - **Javivi** — Developer - **Raboy** — Animator - **Flash** — Models / Textures - **Bret06** — Developer - **Artmanoil** — Custom GUI / TexturePack Guy - **Gigoe** — Main Menu / Loading Screen Artist

versions.name: Homestead 2.0
versions.changelog:
⚠️ Before you update

Read through all of the changelogs before updating. Several mods have been removed and some changes can permanently affect your existing world.

Back up your world first. Make a copy of your save folder before loading it on 2.0 so you can roll back if anything looks off.

If you have any items stored in Storage Drawers or Iron Chests: Restocked, follow the migration steps in this section of the 2.0 announcement before updating, or those items will be gone forever.

⚙️ Summary

The Final Content update for Homestead. Lots of bug fixes, lots of changes, and a whole lot of stuff removed and added. Enjoy.
